_comment: Issue #1628: a deep, narrow Infantry column (frontage_override 3 -- 3 files x many ranks) is ordered on a short straight diagonal march centred on its closest approach to the default map's hill block (Battle.TERRAIN rect (1150,380)-(1400,580)) -- a true perpendicular gap of ~226wu, comfortably outside this column's fixed, frontage-based terrain_clearance() (~22.5wu: 0.5*(3-1)*file_pitch_wu()+soldier_body_radius()) but well inside its OLD pivot-radius-based clearance (~356wu, which folded in the column's own depth). Before the fix, PathField read this straight leg as blocked by terrain hundreds of world units away and swung the column ~240wu off its line; after it, the march holds dead straight the whole way. drill mode (no enemy needed -- this demonstrates pathing, not combat).
